국토종주 자전거길 코스와 인증센터를 지도에서 한눈에 보고, 숙소와 날씨까: See Korea's cross-country bike routes and certification centers on one map, and plan a trip with lodging and weather in mind. I'll walk you through it, moving the screen as we go.
여기서 달릴 코스를 골라요. 국토종주, 4대강처럼 묶음으로 모아 볼 수도: Pick the route you want to ride here. You can also browse them in groups like Cross-Country or Four Rivers.
지도 위 노선을 눌러도 바로 그 코스로 들어가요. [[인증]] 푯말이 인: You can also tap a route line on the map to jump straight to that route. The [[Stamp]] signs are certification centers; tap one to see its address and opening hours.
한강종주자전거길에 들어와 봤어요. 인증센터가 지나는 순서대로 나오고, 이: Here's the Hangang River Bike Path. Certification centers are listed in the order you pass them, and tapping a name moves the map there.

국토종주를 6박 7일로 달린다고 치고 일정을 같이 짜 볼게요. 지금 설정: Let's plan a cross-country trip of 6 nights, 7 days together. Your current settings will be put back when the guide ends.
먼저 코스를 골라요. 국토종주라면 충주댐이나 안동댐에 들를지도 아래에서: First pick a route. For the cross-country route, you can also choose below whether to visit Chungju Dam or Andong Dam.
꼭 처음부터 끝까지 달릴 필요는 없어요. 이번 주말엔 여의도에서 충주댐까: You don't have to ride the whole thing. Pick start and finish certification centers to plan just a part, like Yeouido to Chungju Dam this weekend. To ride the other way, like Busan to Incheon, just swap the start and finish.
몇 박인지 적으면 바로 아래에 몇박 며칠과 하루 평균 거리가 나와요. [: Enter the number of nights and you'll see the trip length and average daily distance right below. Press [[Calculate]] and the total distance is split evenly by day, and each day ends at lodging near that point. That's why the daily distances differ a little. You can also change each day separately; I'll show you that in a moment.

어느 날은 150km, 어느 날은 80km처럼 달리고 싶으면 [[이날 거: If you want to ride 150km one day and 80km another, change [[Distance this day]]. [[Where to stay]] lists lodging within the search range before and after that day's finish, and picking one shows it on the map. When you change one day's distance, the following days share the difference equally so the total still adds up. Pressing [[Calculate]] again clears your per-day changes and goes back to the even split.

국토종주가 시작되는 구간이에요. 아라한강갑문에서 한강 자전거길로 이어져요: This is where the cross-country route begins. At Ara Hangang Lock it joins the Hangang River bike path. The start is close to Geomam Station on the AREX airport line.
경인아라뱃길 운하를 따라 달리는 평탄한 길: A flat path along the Gyeongin Ara Waterway canal
출발점 부근 정서진(국토종주 출발 기념 지점): Jeongseojin near the start (the cross-country starting landmark)
서울 구간(아라한강갑문~팔당대교, 56km)과 남한강 구간(팔당대교~충주: It's split into the Seoul section (Ara Hangang Lock to Paldang Bridge, 56km) and the Namhangang section (Paldang Bridge to Chungju Tangeumdae, 132km). The Chungju Dam certification center is needed for the Hangang River certification, but not for the cross-country one. It's at the end of a spur you ride out and back on, leaving the main line near Mokhaeng Bridge. From October 26, 2026, Jamsugyo Bridge is closed to cars, but bikes can still cross. During paving work in summer 2027, though, bikes will also have to go around via Banpo Bridge for about a month and a half.
서울 도심 한강변 교량과 야경: Hangang bridges and night views in downtown Seoul
팔당 이후 옛 중앙선 철길을 활용한 구간: Section on the old Jungang Line railway after Paldang
두물머리와 북한강철교: Dumulmeori and the Bukhangang Railway Bridge
본선 70.4km 말고 27.1km짜리 우회 노선이 따로 있어요. 두물머: Besides the 70.4km main line, there's a separate 27.1km detour route. The route branches off the Namhangang route at Balgeun Square near Dumulmeori and isn't part of the cross-country route. In the rainy season, the riverside path can flood when Uiam Dam releases water.
옛 경춘선 철길을 활용한 구간: Section on the old Gyeongchun Line railway
청평호·의암호 호반 풍경: Lakeside views of Cheongpyeongho and Uiamho lakes
국토종주에서 유일하게 큰 고개를 넘는 구간이에요. 해발 548m 이화령은: The only section of the cross-country route that crosses a big pass. Ihwaryeong Pass (548m) has about 5km of climbing and about 6km of descent.
백두대간 이화령 고개(해발 548m): Ihwaryeong Pass on the Baekdudaegan ridge (548m)
389km는 안동댐부터 잰 거리예요. 국토종주에서는 상주 상풍교부터 하굿: The 389km is measured from Andong Dam. The cross-country route only covers Sangju Sangpung Bridge to the estuary barrage, leaving out Andong Dam to Sangpung Bridge (about 65km). There are climbs between Hapcheon-Changnyeong Weir and Changnyeong-Haman Weir.
상주 경천대와 경천섬: Gyeongcheondae and Gyeongcheonseom Island in Sangju
강정고령보 디아크 문화관: The ARC culture center at Gangjeong-Goryeong Weir
4대강 종주에 들어가는 노선이에요. 출발점은 신탄진역에서 1km도 안 돼: Part of the Four Rivers certification. The start is less than 1km from Sintanjin Station. The staffed certification center at Daecheong Dam is closed for construction until December 2026, but the unstaffed booth is open.
공주 공산성과 무령왕릉: Gongsanseong Fortress and the Tomb of King Muryeong in Gongju
부여 백마강·낙화암: Baengmagang River and Nakhwaam Rock in Buyeo
금강하굿둑 일대 겨울 철새(가창오리): Winter migratory birds (Baikal teal) around Geumgang Estuary Barrage
4대강 종주에 들어가는 노선이에요. 느러지 인증센터는 언덕 위 전망대 옆: Part of the Four Rivers certification. The Neureoji certification center is next to the observatory on top of the hill. The new riverside deck path takes you right past it, so head up the hill. Riders have reported that the path between Neureoji and Juksan Weir was washed out by floods in summer 2025, and we couldn't confirm whether it's been repaired. Check a way around before you go.
담양 메타세쿼이아 가로수길과 관방제림: Damyang's Metasequoia-lined road and Gwanbangjerim Forest
임실 섬진강생활체육공원(섬진강댐 인근): Imsil Seomjingang Sports Park (near Seomjingang Dam)
영산강과 잇는 연결 노선(26km쯤)이 따로 있어요. 횡탄정 인증센터는: There's a separate connector route (about 26km) linking it to the Yeongsangang route. Riders say the Hoengtanjeong Pavilion certification center is easy to miss coming downstream, as trees hide it.
남도대교(다리 건너 하동 화개장터): Namdo Bridge (cross it for Hwagae Market in Hadong)
새재자전거길 행촌교차로에서 갈라져 금강 합강공원까지 잇는 연결 노선이에요: A connector route that branches off the Saejae Bike Path at Haengchon Intersection and runs to Hapgang Park on the Geumgang. Watch out for small bridges with no shoulder and stretches with truck traffic. A rider reported that in June 2025 the stamps at Baengno Park, Goegang Bridge and Haengchon Intersection had no ink. It's a good idea to also take a photo at the center or check in with the app.
미호천 철새와 갈대밭: Migratory birds and reed beds on Mihocheon Stream
난이도가 가장 높은(5단계) 해안 노선이에요. 통일전망대 인증센터는 민통: The hardest coastal route (level 5). The Unification Observatory certification center is outside the Civilian Control Line, near the entry registration office. In July and August the beach sections get crowded, and when high waves close Heonhwa-ro you'll have to detour about 13km between Jeongdongjin and Mukho. There's a record (2024) of the Chuam Candlestick Rock stamp missing its stamp face, so also take a photo or check in with the app.
작은 오르내림이 잦고 갓길이 좁은 곳이 있어요. 특히 축산항~해맞이공원: Lots of short ups and downs, and some narrow shoulders. The stretch from Chuksan Port to Haemaji Park is especially steep. Some coastal roads have no streetlights, so it's best to ride in daylight. South of Yeongdeok (toward Pohang) isn't a certified route yet.
관동팔경 월송정: Wolsongjeong Pavilion, one of the Eight Scenic Views of Gwandong
제주도의 유인 인증 창구(용두암·제주공항)에서는 제주환상자전거길 인증만: At Jeju's staffed certification desks (Yongduam Rock and Jeju Airport), you can only get the Jeju Island Loop Bike Path certification. The route loops around the island's coast. Riding counterclockwise (Yongduam → Iho Tewoo → Aewol) keeps you in the lane on the sea side, so you cross the road less. The passport sales and certification desk is near Gate 1 on the 1st floor of Jeju Airport. A rider reported sand and mud in a construction zone between Hamdeok and Yongduam in June 2026.
애월·신창풍차 해안도로: Aewol and Sinchang Windmill coastal road

제주환상자전거길 인증만 받을 수 있어요. 다른 노선이나 국토종주 인증은: Only the Jeju Island Loop Bike Path certification is available here. Other routes and the cross-country certification aren't.
인천 아라서해갑문에서 부산 낙동강하굿둑까지 이어 달리는 대표 인증 코스예: The signature certification route, riding all the way from Ara West Sea Lock in Incheon to Nakdonggang Estuary Barrage in Busan. You ride Ara → Hangang → Namhangang → Saejae → Nakdonggang, in that order.
낙동강자전거길은 상주 상풍교~낙동강하굿둑 구간만 포함되고, 안동댐~상풍교: Only the Sangju Sangpung Bridge to Nakdonggang Estuary Barrage part of the Nakdonggang River Bike Path is included; Andong Dam to Sangpung Bridge is left out. You need stamps from all 26 certification centers on the way. The Chungju Dam certification center is only needed for the Hangang River certification, not for the cross-country one.

인증수첩은 4,000원이에요(비닐커버·안내지도는 각 500원). 수첩을: The certification passport costs 4,000 won (vinyl cover and guide map are 500 won each). Buy one by showing ID at a staffed certification center that sells passports, or order online from Woorigang Help Desk after verifying your identity (shipping paid on delivery). Since September 2022 it's one passport per person under your real name, so you can't pass it on, and one passport records every section.
수첩을 사면 받은 일련번호 스티커를 붙이고 앞면에 인적사항을 적어 두세요: When you buy the passport, stick on the serial number sticker you get and write your details on the front. That way your record is safe even if you lose it. Use the stamp in the red unstaffed booth at each certification center on the matching box in your passport. You have to stamp every center in a section, from the first to the last. If a stamp is broken or out of ink, take a photo of the booth or check in with the app.
유인 인증센터에서 바로 확인받거나, 연락처와 주소를 적은 수첩을 무인 부: Get it checked on the spot at a staffed certification center, or write your contact details and address in the passport and drop it in the certification box at an unstaffed booth. After checking, they'll mail your passport and certification sticker back (1–2 weeks). App records alone don't count; you need the passport.
인증서와 인증 스티커는 무료예요. 메달은 완주 확인 뒤 우리강 이용도우미: The certificate and certification sticker are free. Medals are ordered separately from Woorigang Help Desk (1577-4359) once your finish is confirmed. Cross-Country and Four Rivers medals are 7,500 won, the Grand Slam medal is 8,000 won (shipping included), and a medal case is 4,500 won.
행정안전부 '자전거 행복나눔' 앱은 2026년에도 운영 중이에요. 자전거: The Ministry of the Interior and Safety's 'Bike Happiness Sharing' (자전거 행복나눔) app is still running in 2026. Sign up on the Bike Happiness Sharing website and register your passport number, then check in near a certification center (within about 40m) by automatic location or QR code. Records take 1–3 weeks to show up, and some riders say theirs never did, so use it as a backup to your passport stamps (inquiries 1522-8643).
국토종주 총거리는 흔히 633km라고 하지만, 공식 구간 거리를 더하면: The cross-country route is often said to be 633km, but the official section distances add up to 637km.
